people.name: Hiram
people.line: King of Tyre, ally of David and Solomon.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
translations.bsb: And Hiram sent his servants, sailors who knew the sea, to serve in the fleet with Solomon’s servants.
translations.kjv: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
translations.asv: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
